_about: Hand-reviewed Kalshi series <-> Polymarket event families for title-similarity (fuzzy) pairs. approved = rules read side by side and they resolve on the same event, so the pair may be labelled guaranteed (all other checks still apply). rejected = different questions; the pair is dropped. Anything not listed is 'unreviewed': shown as unverified and listed in data/processed/series_review.csv. review_by = approval lapses to unreviewed after this date. To add a family: read BOTH rules texts in full, then add an entry with a note saying why they match. See MATCHING_REVIEW.md.
